warrant.statement: The noun names a part of a specified whole. This explicit partitive construction supplies the definition's own part content, independently of whether the whole is an artifact, location, body or interval.
The noun's explicit genus is a person. The following relative clause describes coordinated properties of that person. The shared genus continues to denote someone.
The singular lexical genus is explicitly a word, further specified by its use, meaning or properties. This supplies the own lexical word component within the reviewed exact construction.
An identified part within an explicit partitive noun definition denotes something of the named whole. The word-scale assignment leaves the whole's referent and the binding to sentence structure.
